name: mneme-monorepo
description: Mneme — the memory layer for your codebase. Knows the WHY, the WHAT, the WHERE-IT-BREAKS, all in one graph.

scripts.build: tsc -b packages/core packages/embeddings packages/mcp packages/correlator packages/cli
scripts.build:watch: tsc -b -w packages/core packages/embeddings packages/mcp packages/correlator packages/cli
scripts.clean: tsc -b --clean packages/core packages/embeddings packages/mcp packages/correlator packages/cli && rimraf packages/*/dist coverage tests/.tmp
scripts.lint: tsc -b --noEmit packages/core packages/embeddings packages/mcp packages/cli packages/correlator
